response.overview: A groundbreaking feat in independent cinema, 'Dream' is India's first-ever mobile-made sci-fi thriller, shot and edited entirely on a mobile device as a massive-scale, zero-budget passion project. As the future collapses under Artificial Super Intelligence, two paths collide—one driven by loss, the other by kindness. Against the unstoppable power of nature, this high-concept film explores a tense mystery that blurs the boundaries of time, human perception, and technological ambition.
response.title: Dream
